admission_and_effect_laws: Artifact Type admission supplies a carrier contract only.
Relation Kind admission permits exact pair and qualifier contracts only.
Typed Relation admission establishes one global connection only.
Appending an ontology semantic event changes one ontology-local subject state only.
Appending a governance event records governance state for one exact semantic epoch only.
Projecting a global Typed Relation into an Ontology creates no new global connection.
Calculating a Cut or View creates no semantic, governance, admission, or runtime authority.
Runtime adoption or activation executes only its exact admitted binding and cannot admit Definitions, Artifact Types, Relation Kinds, Typed Relations, nodes, or edges.
claim_ceiling: This candidate maps selected and admitted evidence, identifies integration gaps, and proposes seven Artifact Type actions. It does not amend a selected convention, rewrite historical bytes, admit a carrier or instance, add a relation endpoint pair, migrate an ontology, or activate a runtime.

cross_layer_mappings.rule: An Ontology Node represents an exact subject revision in one Ontology; it never becomes or replaces the represented artifact.
A projected Ontology Edge preserves the exact global connection and cannot amend it.
A local Ontology Edge is canonical only inside its Ontology and cannot be used as a global Typed Relation.

Global connections use admitted Relation Kinds. A projected edge retains that reference. A local-only edge uses a separately governed ontology-local relation type and does not silently enter the global namespace.
The latest node or edge state is calculated from canonical semantic events; mutable records and projections are not replay inputs.
Governance state joins only through an exact semantic event tuple and cannot patch semantic state.
A View filters one consistent Cut for a purpose and consumer; neither becomes canonical event history.

identity_and_lifecycle_invariants: Artifact instance identity, Ontology Node identity, and the represented subject binding are three separate values.
Typed Relation identity and Ontology Edge identity remain separate even for a projected edge.
One global Typed Relation may be projected into several Ontologies; each edge has its own ontology-local lifecycle.
Retiring a projected Ontology Edge does not retire its global Typed Relation; retiring a global Typed Relation does not erase historical ontology events.
An ontology-local edge never becomes global through export, projection, schema validity, shared labels, or repeated use.
Ontology lifecycle active, retired, removed remains independent of admission, maturity, promotion, confidence, projection freshness, and runtime activation.
Semantic events change meaning-bearing state; governance events record governance posture for an exact semantic epoch and cannot rewrite it.
A calculated Cut, View, snapshot, index, graph, or Markdown rendering is never accepted as canonical replay input.

non_collapse_cases.reason: Global connection versus ontology-scoped projected or local connection.
Global semantic connection contract versus modeling-language structural signature.
Governed meaning layer versus stable configuration and identity record.
Ontology subject versus calculated consumer read model.
Complete consistent state at a cursor versus purpose-bounded selection for a consumer.
Ontology-specific projection versus broader task-ready context projection that may cite several sources.
Meaning-bearing history versus governance observation history joined to exact semantic epochs.
Subject availability versus independent admission, maturity, confidence, challenge, or authority posture.
Replay authority versus discardable calculated output.
Ontology or modeling namespace meaning versus globally admitted connection vocabulary.

objective: Integrate admitted Lab semantics, Artifact Type carriers, global Typed Relations, ontology-local subjects, event histories, projections, contexts, and the adopted bounded runtime without collapsing their identities, lifecycles, authority, or source direction.

relation_namespaces.authority: Ontology Lifecycle business ontology candidate/admitted epoch

relation_token_collisions.rule: Equal text across namespaces does not establish identity, equivalence, inheritance, admission, or automatic mapping. Every bridge requires an explicit mapping artifact and evidence on both sides.

runtime_state.effective_boundary: Exact adopted Rust library plus one authorized and successfully materialized local CLI instance. No daemon, persistent active service, repository enforcement, general legacy migration, cutover, publication, deployment, or external effect is established.
